title: fix(app-shell): a package's non-first app opens itself from the avatar menu, palette, switcher, Home tiles and report index
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbY8Pr8LLL2qGdRbADdMGJi1)_

Fixes #29024

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The two lines are copied from the claim (comment 6575066708) and its amendment (comment 6575119383).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：头像菜单里的隐藏应用入口，改为链接到该应用自己的地址（`appAddressSegment`）：包 ID 能回到它本身时用包 ID，否则用应用名。⌘K 面板的「切换应用」、顶栏应用切换器、首页「Your apps」磁贴（含 `app:launcher` 块）和空报表索引页的「其他应用」链接同病同治。
- 为什么改：`/apps/包ID` 总是打开该包的第一个应用。一个与主应用同包的隐藏应用（例如设置类应用）从头像菜单点进去，落到的是主应用，这个隐藏应用从菜单根本到不了（QA #29002 复现 3 次）。同包的其他非首个应用在上述四处也会被带到第一个应用。
- 风险与回滚：只改链接地址的计算；包内唯一或第一个应用的地址不变（仍是包 ID），这一点有测试钉住。`HomeAppsStrip` 新增必填 prop `routeApps`（内部组件，未导出）。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`layout/AppHeader.tsx` 隐藏应用 `DropdownMenuItem` 的 `onClick`；`console/home/HomeAppsStrip.tsx` 的 `routeApps` 与磁贴 `to`；新测试 `AppHeader.hiddenAppAddress-29024.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppHeader.hiddenAppAddress-29024.test.tsx`，预期 4 个用例通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Avatar menu** (`layout/AppHeader.tsx`): the hidden-app entry navigates to `/apps/` plus `appAddressSegment(metadataApps, app)`, the app's one address among the metadata app list, instead of `appRouteSegment(app) ?? app.name` (its package id). `appAddressSegment` is the existing helper in `utils/appRoute.ts` that `AppContent` already resolves the open app's address with; no new helper.
- **Same defect, same fix**, measured at each site before editing and fixed the same way:
  - `chrome/CommandPalette.tsx`: the "Switch app" item hands `onAppChange` the app's address among the palette's `apps` (the metadata list, hidden apps included).
  - `layout/AppSwitcher.tsx`: each row hands `onAppChange` the app's address among the metadata list.
  - `console/home/HomeAppsStrip.tsx`: a tile links to the app's address among a new required prop, `routeApps`, the list `/apps/SEGMENT` resolves on. The strip only holds the launcher list (hidden apps filtered out), so resolving among the tiles would still misroute a visible app whose package's first app is hidden. Its two callers pass the metadata list: `console/home/HomePage.tsx` and `views/app-launcher-renderer.tsx` (the `app:launcher` block). The prop stays internal; the strip is not exported.
  - `views/AppReportIndexView.tsx`: the empty index's "Reports in your other apps" links carry the app's address among the metadata list.
- **Left as is:** `console/home/AppCard.tsx` builds the same package-id address for its favourite, but nothing renders it (zero JSX call sites; exported only from `console/home/index.ts`, which nothing imports, and absent from the package's `exports`).
- An app that is its package's only or first app keeps its package-id address everywhere.

## Tests

- `layout/__tests__/AppHeader.hiddenAppAddress-29024.test.tsx`, the card's reproduction through the avatar-menu harness of `AppHeader.myOrganizations`: `com.qa.r6nav` ships `qsixn_app` (first) and hidden `qsixn_hidden_app`; the hidden entry navigates to `/apps/qsixn_hidden_app`. A hidden app alone in its package keeps `/apps/com.qa.solo`; a hidden app that is its package's first app keeps `/apps/com.qa.lead`; visible apps are not menu entries.
- `chrome/CommandPalette.packageAppAddress-29024.test.tsx`: a package's second app is switched to by name, the first by package id.
- `layout/__tests__/AppSwitcher.packageAppAddress-29024.test.tsx`: same, plus a visible app behind its package's hidden first app is switched to by name.
- `console/home/__tests__/HomeAppsStrip.packageAppAddress-29024.test.tsx`: tile hrefs for a second app, an app behind a hidden first app, and an app alone in its package.
- `views/__tests__/AppReportIndex.otherAppsAddress-29024.test.tsx`: the other-apps links for a package's first and second app.
- `HomeAppsStrip.branding-27386` and `HomeAppsStrip.tilesAreLinks-12305` pass `routeApps` (their pinned hrefs are unchanged).
- Ablation (one-shot, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to HEAD's blob, `git diff HEAD` empty): the avatar entry back to the package-id address (`app._packageId ?? app.name`, what `appRouteSegment(app) ?? app.name` computes) turns the card's case red (expected `/apps/qsixn_hidden_app`, received `/apps/com.qa.r6nav`); the two keep-address cases stay green.

## Acceptance notes

- **Finding for the seat, not fixed here:** inside a package's non-first app, the sidebar's navigation links are built on `appRouteSegment(activeApp)` (`UnifiedSidebar` `basePath`; `nav-menu-renderer` builds its `basePath` the same way), so they point at the package's first app. Measured through the real `UnifiedSidebar`, `MetadataProvider` and route helpers (jsdom): with `crm` and `crm_service` sharing `com.example.crm`, inside `crm_service` its "Cases" entry links to `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_case`, which opens `crm`.
- Real browser: NOT MEASURED. The two-app package was not staged on the showcase; the avatar-menu test above stands in for the card's browser reproduction.
